exposure_matched_benchmark.purpose: Separate stock-selection/implementation performance from residual-cash exposure.

cross_sectional_tests.random_selection_universe: same PIT-eligible universe on each decision date

classification.weak_fragile: Positive primary result that fails the moderate criteria or materially depends on one implementation/cost assumption; cross-sectional and portfolio evidence may disagree.
classification.inconclusive: Any case not meeting the definitions above, including unresolved data/accounting defects or evidence too weak to distinguish the observed result from noise.

invalidity_rules: Required PIT membership cannot be reconstructed.
Corporate-action accounting has an unexplained share/cash discontinuity.
Transaction ledger cannot reconcile holdings, cash, and NAV.
Execution uses a price unavailable at the decision timestamp.
Protected holdout influenced a pre-classification strategy/configuration decision.
Configuration cannot be reproduced from its recorded hash and Git commit.

time_budget.stop_rule: If validation gates are not passed within 8 weeks, narrow replay scope only by explicitly documenting the omitted event classes; never silently skip a gate or authorize performance.

A_SIGNAL_LEVEL_DIAGNOSTIC.implementation: fractional/notional capital with the frozen signal, execution, cost and universe rules; no whole-share residual-cash constraint
A_SIGNAL_LEVEL_DIAGNOSTIC.classification: PASS if threshold and pre-registered inference criteria are met; INCONCLUSIVE if evidence does not distinguish the effect from noise; FAIL if the observed effect is non-positive and the null test does not support selection information.

B_RETAIL_IMPLEMENTATION.implementation: ₹25,000 whole shares, next actual trading-day open, 0.10% slippage, ZERODHA_DATE_EFFECTIVE, NO_REPLACEMENT_RETAIN_CASH
B_RETAIL_IMPLEMENTATION.classification: PASS only when the frozen implementation clears the economic threshold and the pre-registered robustness/inference gates; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL according to the registered rules.

estimands.claims_rule: A may not rescue, replace, or redefine B. Any A result must be reported with its own PASS/INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL classification.

economic_threshold_rationale.rationale: A 1.00 percentage-point annualized net excess hurdle is an explicit economic-materiality threshold for a concentrated bespoke strategy. It is intentionally above the approximately 0.30–0.31% TER currently shown by Nifty 200 Momentum products, so a positive result must clear more than a low-cost passive momentum product's fee level.
economic_threshold_rationale.note: This is a pre-registered project decision, not a claim that 1.00 percentage point is a universal statistical threshold.

random5_null.statistic: mean_net_excess_return_per_quarter of frozen Top-5 portfolio versus each random-5 portfolio
random5_null.sampling_universe: all 50 PIT-eligible NIFTY 50 names on each decision date
random5_null.sampling: 5 names without replacement from all eligible names; do not pre-filter to buyable names
random5_null.unbuyable_rule: Apply the exact frozen ₹25,000 whole-share buyability rule to every random draw; an unbuyable selected name becomes residual cash under NO_REPLACEMENT_RETAIN_CASH. Do not replace it and do not redraw.
random5_null.costs_and_execution: Use the same next-actual-trading-day-open execution, 0.10% slippage, ZERODHA_DATE_EFFECTIVE costs, and dividend/corporate-action accounting as the frozen primary implementation.
random5_null.p_value: one-sided Monte Carlo p-value for the observed Top-5 excess versus the random-5 null; plus-one correction.
random5_null.expected_outcome: INCONCLUSIVE is an explicitly expected and acceptable outcome because the sample contains only 31 quarterly decision dates.

independent_implementation.requirement: A second implementation must be written from this specification alone without inspecting, copying, or refactoring the first implementation.
independent_implementation.style_constraint: Use a materially different implementation style, e.g. explicit chronological loops and dictionaries rather than vectorized/pandas logic.
independent_implementation.acceptance: Exact equality of the five selected symbols on all 31 quarterly decision dates, including rank ordering where ties are relevant.
independent_implementation.mismatch_rule: Any mismatch is a specification-resolution gate failure. Resolve the ambiguity in the specification first; do not patch one implementation merely to force agreement.

dividend_timing.convention: Historical ingestion must explicitly encode ex-date, record-date, and payment-date semantics before ledger replay.
dividend_timing.test_requirement: At least one real historical dividend case must be replayed through the ledger with entitlement and cash-credit timing checked against authoritative source records.

gate1_rule.required_for_pass: For every NIFTY 50 constituent change used in 2018-2025 reconstruction, record the official announcement/publication date and the effective date separately; announcement date must precede effective date.
gate1_rule.evidence: Official NSE/NSE Indices publication or circular; repository filename dates alone are not sufficient.
gate1_rule.failure: Any unresolved announcement/effective-date mismatch blocks all downstream gates.
